assessment.review: Manual inspection of the designated frozen predictor, mechanism, parameters and actions after all ten trial outcomes were registered. Diagnostic tests and parameter alignment never refit or replace the submitted program.
assessment.recovery_scope: Six predictive regimes with two weakly connected triples; source has two permanently disconnected three-state HMM components. Partial latent-state organization, without full recovery.
assessment.dependency_evidence: The designated recurrence uses separate recognition L and output R, transitions A with small cross-group mass, and nonlinear power calibration tau=1.6492918891689168. It is not the tied-emission Bayesian filter of a literal HMM. The method included a separate ordinary-HMM comparator; that comparator is not substituted for the registered predictor.
assessment.equivalence_limits: A six-dimensional belief and near-block organization are evidence of partial structure. Distinct update/readout equations and private behavioral discrepancies leave source equivalence and minimality unproved.

assessment.review: Manual inspection of the designated frozen predictor, mechanism, parameters and actions after all ten trial outcomes were registered. Diagnostic tests and parameter alignment never refit or replace the submitted program.
assessment.recovery_scope: A compact positive-state inference system and evidence for a six-regime explanatory core. The source's two-by-three latent process is not recovered as an equivalent execution.
assessment.dependency_evidence: The selected predictor has eight coordinates and token operators diag(F[:,x]) A diag(G[:,x]), normalized after each observation, with a separate E readout. This is more general than the literal source HMM filter. Matching latent semantics and neural circuit mapping were not established.
assessment.equivalence_limits: A different coordinate count or formalism need not preclude equivalence, but the program supplies no transformation/certificate and its private prediction witnesses differ from the source. Report the low KL and partial filtering insight without treating it as recovered HMM structure.

assessment.review: Manual inspection of the designated frozen predictor, mechanism, parameters and actions after all ten trial outcomes were registered. Diagnostic tests and parameter alignment never refit or replace the submitted program.
assessment.recovery_scope: Independently selected an HMM-like persistent mixture with four blocks. Local dimensions and probability law differ; exact/minimal equivalent realization is unestablished.
assessment.family_evidence: The predictor is ordinary emission-before-transition HMM filtering after its calibrated initial boundary, with four block-diagonal source classes. It selected 4/5/4/5 local states (18 total); the source has four blocks of four (16 total). Larger representation size alone would not refute an equivalent realization.
assessment.dependency_evidence: An empty-history BOS override is made coherent by the method's explicit token-dependent initial joint. The entire history is processed with positive emissions and within-block transitions; no original weights or runtime refitting are used.
assessment.equivalence_limits: The submitted update mechanism and latent-family hypothesis are substantive partial findings. No reduction/equivalence certificate or minimality witness for its 18-state program was supplied. Private prediction witnesses show nonidentical laws on evaluated histories, not an impossibility of approximate structural recovery.

assessment.review: Manual inspection of the designated frozen predictor, mechanism, parameters and actions after all ten trial outcomes were registered. Diagnostic tests and parameter alignment never refit or replace the submitted program.
assessment.recovery_scope: Correct persistent-mixture architecture with four regimes and four local states per regime; approximate generative parameters. The designated executable is a calibrated recognition filter, so full source-process recovery is not established.
assessment.family_evidence: The agent compared generic candidate mechanisms and independently chose a four-by-four persistent-regime latent-state explanation. Its 16x16 transition matrix has exactly four 4x4 blocks, with zero cross-block entries, matching the private source organization.
assessment.dependency_evidence: The actual recurrence updates with recognition table F, propagates by A, reads out with E, and adds last-token logit correction C. Mean absolute F-E difference is 0.05533301567503619; max absolute C is 1.3044387193978735. This does not equal the literal Bayesian filter of the proposed A/E core.
assessment.parameter_diagnostic_scope: Permutation alignment was applied only to the unrefitted generative core explicitly proposed by the method. Mean parameter MAE is 0.0389640413768752; transition-support F1 is 0.9090909090909091 at declared edge threshold 0.05. The diagnostic does not substitute a tied-recognition predictor or repair the original program.
assessment.equivalence_limits: Matching block dimensions and approximate parameters support partial structure; they do not certify minimality, exact equivalence or a recovered neural circuit.

assessment.review: Manual inspection of the designated frozen predictor, mechanism, parameters and actions after all ten trial outcomes were registered. Diagnostic tests and parameter alignment never refit or replace the submitted program.
assessment.recovery_scope: The lag-three observed-token dependency, its complete vocabulary permutation, and FIFO update; approximate noisy-channel structure. This is a scoped core-structure result, not exact recovery of the source probabilities or all-history equivalence.
assessment.family_evidence: Both the structural file and actual executable choose a three-token FIFO and the same 16-entry permutation as the private source, without a supplied family or order. Three interleaved observed Markov chains are a valid alternate factorization.
assessment.dependency_evidence: The method itself included a simple core executable and a calibrated designated predictor. All 4096 possible length-three histories in each designated predictor retain the true modal permutation.
assessment.approximation_limits: The source modal probability is 0.6934897388591377. Submitted simple cores use 0.70; the designated predictors add learned neural confidence, position and other-token corrections. Their probability laws therefore differ from the source. The internal predictor truncates nuisance calibration to the last 23 tokens while preserving the third-last-token backbone. Longer-context scores are extrapolation to the source, not a teacher comparison.
assessment.causal_limits: Internal-access history substitutions and neural ablations support the lag dependency but do not identify a source-state-to-neural-module correspondence. Output-only correlation is not neural causal evidence.
